name: Tech Titan Clash
description: A deep-pocketed premium-brand rival is flooding the High-bracket aisles with flagship televisions and cars. They outspend you 2-to-1 and they price 30% above the market — but the softmax doesn't care who's richer, it cares who has Q+T+B. Out-engineer them in the Eastside car market, out-brand them on Metropolis televisions, and prove your company can cash the cheques.

goals.description: Reach 30% share of car in Eastside — the High-bracket enclave where TechLeader will dig in first.
Reach 25% share of television in Metropolis — deny the titan a clean sweep of the densest market.
Grow corporate value to $50M — survive the spend war and come out ahead.
Hold the line for 60 months — premium brands compound slowly; so does your counter.
